text:
maya: Heads up — sampleapp CI caught a parity issue between SDK listRoutes and the REST API. REST returns paginated results with `cursor` but the SDK seems to drop the cursor and eventually 401s after a few pages.

samir: Can you paste the minimal repro? SDK call + headers vs curl?

maya: Repro:
`// node sample`
`const routes = await client.routes.list({limit: 50});`
`// returns 200 first call with next_cursor but subsequent call uses undefined cursor and then 401`

`curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/routes?limit=50&cursor=abc123'`
`// returns 200 and next_cursor works`

natalie: Hmm — is the SDK storing the cursor in the response wrapper or returning it separately? We recently changed list responses to include `meta.next_cursor` for REST. SDK might still expect `next_cursor` at top-level.

maya: Looks like that — REST: `{"data":[...],"meta":{"next_cursor":"abc123"}}` but SDK search code expects `resp.next_cursor`. So it passes `undefined` as cursor param on next request. After 2-3 calls, token gets flagged and API responds 401 (rate/abuse guard).

samir: That explains. Two issues: param shape drift (`meta.next_cursor` vs `next_cursor`) and no defensive check before sending undefined cursor.

maya: Proposed quick fix: SDK should accept both shapes and normalize: `const cursor = resp.meta?.next_cursor ?? resp.next_cursor`. Also guard: `if (!cursor) break` in the auto-paginate loop.

tony: Also check auth refresh flow — the SDK refresher currently retries once then gives up when the backend returns 401 with `x-auth-retry: true`. REST client handles that header and rotates the ephemeral token. SDK doesn't.

natalie: Good catch. I remember a commit that flipped the auth refresh header name for private deployments. Could be we missed backwards compat. We should add support for both `x-auth-retry` and `x-ephemeral-refresh` and add tests.

maya: Filing a small follow-up: reproduce script + failing logs attached to the issue. Short-term patch to SDK in patch branch to normalize cursor and respect header.

samir: Can you add a unit test that simulates `meta.next_cursor` and the header cases? Also add e2e in sampleapp CI to call listRoutes with mocked pagination + auth bounce.

maya: Yep. I pushed a branch `fix/sdk-paginate-auth-compat` with a failing test + notes. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/412

devex-bot: CI pipeline for sampleapp/pull/412 failed on `node 18 matrix` — error shows `UnhandledPromiseRejection: TypeError: Cannot read property 'meta' of undefined`

natalie: That stack implies some code path returns `undefined` resp — add null check before destructure. Also check SDK call sites where `response` may be the raw body or an envelope.

maya: Will update branch in a bit. Thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:

samir: After fix, let's add a small compatibility note to the SDK changelog and a devx guide for migrating REST -> SDK pagination shapes. Saves future confusion.

maya: Agreed — adding to release notes and the onboarding sample.

tony: low-priority: add a debug log when SDK sees unknown pagination keys so we can catch other shape drifts early.

maya: excellent idea. I'll include it in the PR.

samir: marking this thread as actionable — I'll link the follow-up ticket on the SDK board.

maya: Thanks all, closing the loop once CI green. :rocket:
